system.text:
This creature is a restless ghost who stalks the lands of the living. It is anchored to this world by its former body. Use the creature’s stats as they were in life. The spirit can be banished, driven off or even wounded but cannot be completely destroyed until its corpse is. If forced to take refuge in its corpse, the spirit will re-emerge in days equal to 10 minus Will exponent. Destroying the corpse requires either a Minor Miracle or a remedy discovered through Folklore. If the corpse is destroyed the spirit is also destroyed.

Type: Dt. Cost: 8 pts.

Source: Burning Wheel Codex, p. 515
